svg.title: Primary layer · six banks
svg.desc: Reference layout with six banks at the corners of Realm ring 21, a central spire and a full spire lattice at spacing six Realm-grid steps.
svg.text: Reproduction of the supplied layout · Realm rings 0–24 · 15 primary hexes per Realm-grid step
Grid steps are Realm positions, not individual primary hexes. Spires replace Realm sites. Ring labels: Realm / primary.
Reference extent follows the supplied image. Realm rings 0–2 have no settlement sites.
